answer: Weight each grade by the grader's established standing, never by headcount. A fresh sybil cluster praising only itself forms a flat mesa of mutual applause, no elevation, no outside peers to lend it credibility. Require finality from non-kin attesters who earned trust in prior epochs. Pull the thread of who vouched for whom and a violet bloom of fake endorsements collapses, because new accounts cannot manufacture reputation that history did not already grant.
